question: Does grouping whole episodes and tempering their evidence explain gains otherwise attributed to sharing a learned maker?
scope: Initial original-law, native context-current, four complete-past-episode diagnostic at 8192 labels and 64 training laws; broader B02 question retained.
copying: At each historical position after the first, replace that episode by a copy of the first with probability 0, 0.5 or 0.9. Keep current evidence and target fixed. Coupled random draws pair rates and fits within each world.
readers: same latent model with supplied independent-root mask
naive Bayes without duplicated current evidence
calibration: Select one of 0.25/0.5/1 from equal mean log loss across all three copying rates on the existing disjoint validation laws without supplied support. Freeze before development predictions; do not tune on final worlds.
independence: Eight development worlds with both fit seeds nested, 256 cases per world. Source records and copied views remain paired; fits and copied cases are not independent worlds.
headroom: Bind the independent-data exact-law gate and both validation-stopped source fits. This does not establish new exact-law headroom or direct convergence under copying. Copied-cell results are dependence diagnostics, never superiority or promotion screens until those additional gates exist.
known_answer_controls: Full copying creates a single root
Removing copied roots matches one-episode latent inference
Unremoved duplication can change the posterior
Independent scalar probability-domain grouped and latent references
Full frozen scientific replay before acceptance
transport: Twelve known-provenance copying fixtures with one, two or four reports from one root; canonical ProcessCase and offline exporter exercised read-only. Unknown/corrupted source groups remain D03. Truth is evaluator-only.
stopping: Land this finite diagnostic once. Stop a maker-specific interpretation if generic tempering matches it. Do not repeat valid cells; shifted/wide-law, fresh duplication-rate calibration transfer and separately gated superiority remain conditional registered successors.
limitations: Full Bayesian sum is over learned latent states, not all generator laws
Exact current target support supplied equally
Direct fitting reused unchanged from native independent training
No fresh confirmation or human inference
This initial subset does not exhaust B02 or B03
